nodes.label: ADR-019 — Categorias de variáveis do MPC: CV com SP, Restrição por faixa (com precedência)

Decision: four variable categories — MV (hard limits, Du max), CV (setpoint tracking), Restricao (low/high band, precedence over CVs), DV (feedforward); model matrix rows = CVs+Restricoes, columns = MVs+DVs
nodes.rationale: SP tracking alone does not cover real APC: some variables must only stay inside a band and protecting them outweighs CV tracking. Implemented as soft constraints with slack and dominant penalty — band violation buys SP error, never the reverse. Validation: at least 1 MV and at least 1 CV-or-Restricao; ideal resting values out of v1.
